text:
Hi there, and thanks for contacting Leafy! 🌱

Good question. Here's how it works for opened soil:

- **Opened soil can't be returned for change of mind.** Once a bag of soil (or fertiliser) has been opened, it isn't eligible for return.
- **The exception is a faulty product.** If the soil is faulty, you can still return it. Faulty items return free of charge.

If your soil is faulty, here's what to do:

- Go to **"My Orders"** and start a return. This needs to be within **30 days** of delivery.
- A prepaid return label will be emailed to you. It expires after **7 days**, so drop the parcel off within that time.
- Your refund will be issued within **5 business days** of the return reaching our warehouse, to your original payment method.

If you're not sure whether the issue counts as faulty, tell me what's going on with the soil and I can point you in the right direction, or pass it to a Support Lead if needed.

Is there anything else I can help with? We're always happy to hear from you! 😊
